articles.title: Charlie Sheen’s 1998 Prevost Tour Bus Is For Sale
articles.summary: This 1998 Prevost Marathon XL Bus, famously used by actor Charlie Sheen for many years, including while filming the hit TV show 'Two and a Half Men', has a notable ownership history. Sheen later sold the luxurious coach to musician Tim Montana. This vehicle represents a slice of celebrity memorabilia, transitioning from a well-known actor to a prominent musician, highlighting its unique journey and previous high-profile use.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia says Pakistan sends fighter jets to kingdom under defence pact
articles.summary: Pakistan has deployed fighter jets and military forces to Saudi Arabia to enhance security, fulfilling obligations under an existing defence pact. The Saudi defence ministry confirmed this move, highlighting the deepening military cooperation between Islamabad and Riyadh. This strategic partnership aims to bolster regional stability and collective defence capabilities in the face of ongoing geopolitical developments.

articles.title: One hundred seventy five Russian servicemen are returned from territory controlled by Kiev regime
articles.summary: On April 11, 2026, Russia and Ukraine conducted a significant prisoner of war exchange. A total of 175 Russian servicemen held by Ukraine were returned, while an equal number of 175 Ukrainian Armed Forces (AFU) POWs were repatriated. This mutual exchange highlights ongoing efforts amidst the conflict to return captured personnel to their respective nations, demonstrating a rare instance of cooperation.

articles.title: codepuppy-rs-turbo-parse added to PyPI
articles.summary: This update details Phase 2 enhancements for 'Code Puppy' and 'turbo_parse', emphasizing high-performance parsing and advanced editor-grade features. Leveraging technologies like tree-sitter and PyO3 bindings, the advancements aim to provide powerful capabilities, including improved syntax highlighting. These developments are crucial for robust software development tools, enhancing efficiency in code analysis and interaction for developers working on complex projects. The focus is on boosting software performance.

articles.title: $15 STM32U575 development board features FPC display connector, microSD card slot, two 48-pin GPIO headers
articles.summary: The article focuses on the WeAct Studio STM32U585CIU6 development board, featuring an ultra-low-power STM32U5 Cortex-M33 MCU. This board, integrated into MicroPython v1.28, is ideal for energy-efficient embedded projects. The text explores its capabilities and potentially compares it with other compact microcontroller solutions, providing valuable insights for tech enthusiasts and developers interested in advanced, low-power hardware and programming.
